title: Bounds on an input-derived observation
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $J$ be a finite set of coordinates in $ br^n$, and let $S$ be a finite subset of $J$. For every Boolean target function and every three inputs in the $n$-dimensional sign cube, the restricted Fourier weight observation formed from these inputs lies in $[-1,1]$.
